title: OSSA Cognition Extension (v0.5.0 draft)
description: Reasoning pattern, thought schema, trace configuration, governance, session capabilities, hypothesis behavior, and alignment gates for auditable agent cognition. First-class spec-level primitive for NIST/FedRAMP alignment.

pattern.description: Cognitive architecture pattern: sequential (linear chain), tree_of_thought (branching), react (reason-act-observe), plan_and_execute

max_depth.description: Max thought steps before forced convergence

revision.description: Allow backtracking and revision of prior thoughts

confidence_threshold.description: Minimum confidence to proceed without human review

storage.description: Where thought graphs are stored (vector=embeddings, graph=Neo4j-style)

human_review_triggers.description: Conditions that escalate to human review

audit_required.description: Whether reasoning chain must be retained for compliance audit

session.description: Session capabilities for collaborative multi-agent interactions

joinable.description: Can this agent join collaborative sessions

maxConcurrent.description: Maximum number of concurrent sessions this agent can participate in

role.description: Default role this agent assumes in collaborative sessions

conflictBehavior.description: How the agent handles conflicts during collaborative sessions

hypothesis.description: Hypothesis declaration behavior for transparent agent reasoning

declaresIntent.description: Whether the agent declares its intent before acting

confidenceThreshold.description: Minimum confidence score required to proceed without review

requiresAlignment.description: Whether the agent must pass an alignment gate before executing hypotheses

alignmentGate.description: Alignment gate configuration for hypothesis validation before execution

enabled.description: Whether the alignment gate is active

arbiter.description: Who or what arbitrates alignment decisions

timeout.description: Maximum time to wait for alignment decision (e.g. 5m, 30s, 1h)
